# vcp_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Fetches a list of all SSH keys in your account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all SSH keys in the project.
data "vcp_ssh_keys" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ssh_keys` (Attributes List) List of all SSH keys in your account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--ssh_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_keys`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the SSH key.
- `name` (String) The name of the SSH key.
- `public_key` (String) The public key material in OpenSSH format.
